I wrote the conversion to `output-1.json` through `output-12.json` in the working folder, covering all 678 ids. I did not write a single `output.json`, since the parts are meant to be merged. Each entry is either `{"id", "chain"}` or `{"id", "skip": true, "reason"}`.

**Results (tallied by hand, so treat the counts as approximate):** about 548 converted and about 130 skipped. Most skips use sibling, parent, or ancestor axes, unions (`|`), child or descendant existence tests, or per-parent positions like `//X[1]`, which class chain's index can't reproduce.

**Verification gap:** Bash isn't available in this session, so I couldn't run a parser over the output or run the chains against a simulator. Please check it before relying on it. Run each chain in an Appium session and compare the element count with the original XPath, at least for the index cases.

**Choices I made that you may want to change:**
- XPath `@name` maps to class chain `name`, and `@label`, `@value`, and `@type` map to the same-named attributes.
- `//` becomes `**/`. `*` becomes `XCUIElementTypeAny`.
- `contains()` becomes `CONTAINS`, `starts-with()` becomes `BEGINSWITH`, and `ends-with()` becomes `ENDSWITH`. The `translate()` lowercase case becomes `CONTAINS[c]`, and `lower-case(@label)="ab"` becomes `==[c]`.
- `@enabled="true"` becomes `enabled == 1`, and `"false"` becomes `== 0`.
- Global indexes like `(//X)[n]` become `**/X[n]`, and `[last()]` becomes `[-1]`. This assumes class chain counts indexes across the whole match set in document order. If that's wrong, every indexed chain is affected.
- `//Button[@enabled=true()]` (x294) became all buttons. That assumes WebDriverAgent always emits the `enabled` attribute.
- `(//Button)[last()-1]` (x488) became `[-2]`, which assumes class chain supports negative indexes beyond `-1`.
- Locators that match nothing in XCUITest, because they use `text()`, `@text`, or `contains(.,…)`, were skipped. So were `XCUIElementTypeAny` in XPath (x376), which is a wildcard in class chain but not a real type in XPath, and `XCUIElementTypeLabel` (x348), which I converted and which matches nothing in both.
- Two inputs are not valid XPath (x091, x530). I skipped them rather than convert the intended meaning.
- Values with line breaks (x330, x484, x575) or backticks (x334) were skipped because they can't be written inside a class chain predicate.
- Attributes `hittable`, `accessible`, `selected`, and `placeholderValue` were skipped because I couldn't confirm class chain supports them.
